description: As a remote sensing technician preparing satellite imagery for an urban planning department, enhance the Sentinel-2 true color imagery to improve discrimination of built structures, roads, and other linear infrastructure features. The Sentinel-2 TCI file (sentinel2_tci.tif) is loaded in SNAP Desktop. Apply appropriate spatial filtering techniques to produce enhanced imagery that sharpens edges and highlights structural boundaries, while preserving the original unfiltered bands alongside the enhanced output. Save the complete product in BEAM-DIMAP format and export as GeoTIFF to /home/ga/snap_exports/.

metadata.data_source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A TCI from AWS COGs
